items.title: Address only (user picks amount)
items.expected: Send screen; user can enter amount and optional comment.

items.title: Text only
items.expected: Send screen with comment prefilled; user can enter amount.

items.title: Amount
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing amount; no comment.

items.title: Amount + text
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing amount and comment.

items.title: DNS address + amount
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing amount; DNS resolved.

items.title: Unknown parameter (invalid)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. Any parameters not defined by the standard must cause an error.

items.title: Invalid amount format (invalid)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. amount must be a valid decimal number.

items.title: bin only (no amount)
items.expected: Send screen with binary payload locked; user can enter amount.

items.title: Amount + bin
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing amount; includes binary payload (bin); text 'bin' (default bin).

items.title: Text + bin (invalid)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. text and bin are mutually exclusive.

items.title: Invalid bin format (invalid)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. bin must be valid base64url.

items.title: Amount + exp (30s)
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing amount; valid until exp; after expiration wallet rejects.

items.title: Amount + text + exp (30s)
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing amount and comment; valid until exp; after expiration wallet rejects.

items.title: Amount + bin + exp (30s)
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing amount; includes binary payload (bin); text 'bin' (default bin); valid until exp; after expiration wallet rejects.

items.title: Amount + exp (expires in 5 sec)
items.expected: Confirmation screen; wallet MUST block signing after 5 seconds. Test timing: user should see exp countdown and signing becoming blocked.

items.title: Amount + exp (expires during signing)
items.expected: Confirmation screen; test that wallet handles expiration during signing process (15 sec window).

items.title: Text + exp (no amount)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. exp requires amount.

items.title: Expired (invalid)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. Current time > exp.

items.title: Amount + very large exp (wallet clamps)
items.expected: Wallet should send with its default TTL (e.g., ~5 minutes) even though exp is far in the future.

items.title: Invalid exp format (invalid)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. exp must be a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

items.title: init only (no amount)
items.expected: Send screen with StateInit locked; user can enter amount and optional comment.

items.title: init + text (no amount)
items.expected: Send screen with StateInit locked and comment prefilled; user can enter amount.

items.title: init + bin (no amount)
items.expected: Send screen with StateInit and binary payload locked; user can enter amount.

items.title: Amount + init
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing amount.

items.title: Amount + init + text
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing amount and comment.

items.title: Amount + init + bin
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing amount; includes StateInit and binary payload (bin); text 'bin' (default bin).

items.title: Amount + init + bin + exp (30s)
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing amount; includes StateInit and binary payload (bin); text 'bin' (default bin); valid until exp; after expiration wallet rejects.

items.title: Amount + init + exp (30s)
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing amount; valid until exp; after expiration wallet rejects.

items.title: Amount + invalid init (invalid)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. init is not a valid BOC.

items.title: Jetton master only
items.expected: Jetton send screen; user can enter amount and optional comment.

items.title: Jetton + text (no amount)
items.expected: Jetton send screen with comment prefilled; user can enter amount.

items.title: Jetton + bin (no amount)
items.expected: Jetton send screen with binary payload locked; user can enter amount.

items.title: Jetton + amount
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing jetton amount; no comment.

items.title: Jetton + amount + text
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing jetton amount and comment.

items.title: Jetton + amount + bin
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing jetton amount; includes binary payload (bin); text 'bin' (default bin).

items.title: Jetton + amount + exp (30s)
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing jetton amount; valid until exp; after expiration wallet rejects.

items.title: Jetton + amount + text + exp (30s)
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing jetton amount and comment; valid until exp; after expiration wallet rejects.

items.title: Jetton + amount + exp (expires in 5 sec)
items.expected: Confirmation screen; wallet MUST block signing after 5 seconds. Test timing: user should see exp countdown and signing becoming blocked.

items.title: Jetton + amount + exp (expires during signing)
items.expected: Confirmation screen; test that wallet handles expiration during signing process (15 sec window).

items.title: Jetton + exp (no amount)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. exp requires amount.

items.title: Jetton + text + bin (invalid)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. text and bin are mutually exclusive.

items.title: Jetton expired (invalid)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. Current time > exp.

items.title: Jetton + DNS address
items.expected: Jetton send screen; DNS resolved; user can enter amount.

items.title: Jetton + DNS address + amount
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing jetton amount; DNS resolved.

items.title: Jetton + amount + init (invalid)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. StateInit is not allowed for jetton transfers.

items.title: Jetton + amount + bin + exp (30s)
items.expected: Confirmation screen showing jetton amount; includes binary payload (bin); text 'bin' (default bin); valid until exp; after expiration wallet rejects.

items.title: Unknown parameter (invalid)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. Any parameters not defined by the standard must cause an error.

items.title: Jetton + invalid jetton master (invalid)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. jetton must be a valid address.

items.title: Duplicate parameter (amount twice)
items.expected: Expected: Reject. Duplicate parameters are not allowed.

items.title: Empty text parameter
items.expected: Expected: Reject or treat as no text. Empty parameter values should be handled.

items.title: Empty amount parameter
items.expected: Expected: Reject. Empty parameter values.

items.title: Amount = 0
items.expected: Amount is zero. Check wallet behavior (may show warning or allow for comment-only transfers).

items.title: Invalid recipient address
items.expected: Expected: Reject. Recipient address is not valid.

items.title: Raw address format
items.expected: Confirmation screen. Raw address format should be supported.

items.title: Parameter name case sensitivity
items.expected: Expected: Reject. Parameter names should be case-sensitive (Amount vs amount).

items.title: Different parameter order
items.expected: Confirmation screen. Parameter order should not matter.

items.expected: Opens on‑ramp flow.

items.expected: Opens staking screen.

items.expected: Opens a specific liquidity pool.

items.title: Exchange
items.expected: Opens exchange.

items.title: Swap from tsTON to USDT
items.expected: Opens swap interface prefilled.

items.title: Battery (with promocode)
items.expected: Opens battery screen.

items.expected: Opens transaction bottom sheet for boc.

items.title: DApp (catalog) https URL
